3751	def run_optimizations(
3752	    scene: Scene | None = None,
3753	    in_place: bool = False,
3754	    pack_manager: PackManager | None = None,
3755	) -> dict[str, int]:
3756	    """Run the ``jb``/``jop`` packs and report how much each phase changed.
3757	
3758	    ``in_place=False`` (the default) optimises *clones* of the bodies, so the
3759	    IR that layers 2 and 3 consume keeps every copy statement -- aliasing and
3760	    taint analyses depend on them.
3761	    """
3762	    scene = scene if scene is not None else Scene.v()
3763	    manager = pack_manager if pack_manager is not None else PackManager.v()
3764	    totals: dict[str, int] = {key: 0 for key in OPTIMIZATION_KEYS}
3765	    totals["bodies_optimized"] = 0
3766	    totals["units_before"] = 0
3767	    totals["units_after"] = 0
3768	    for method in scene.get_methods():
3769	        body = method.get_active_body()
3770	        if body is None:
3771	            continue
3772	        target = body if in_place else clone_body(body)
3773	        totals["bodies_optimized"] += 1
3774	        totals["units_before"] += len(target.units)
3775	        for pack_name in ("jb", "jop"):
3776	            for _phase, result in manager.get_pack(pack_name).apply(target).items():
3777	                for key, value in result.items():
3778	                    if key == "iterations":
3779	                        continue
3780	                    totals[key] = totals.get(key, 0) + value
3781	        totals["units_after"] += len(target.units)
3782	        if in_place:
3783	            method.set_active_body(target)
3784	    return totals
